transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I've just been feeling incredibly depressed and sad, and it feels like I've been down for a really long time now. It's been going on for over two years, and I just can't seem to shake this heavy feeling.

During these past two years or even before, have you ever had periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, happy, or hyperactive, needing very little sleep?
No, I've never experienced periods like that at all. I've mostly just felt down, depressed, and really tired instead.
During these past two years, have you had any periods lasting longer than two months where your depression completely went away and you felt like your normal self?

I'm not quite sure, and it's really hard to remember if there was ever a full two-month period where I felt completely back to normal. This depression has just felt like a constant, heavy presence for the last two years.
During these past two years, have you also lost interest or pleasure in almost all the things you used to enjoy?

Yes, absolutely. Over the last two years, I have completely lost interest in all the hobbies and activities I used to love. Even when I try to do them, I just don't feel any sense of pleasure or happiness from them anymore.
How has your sleep been over these past two years? Have you been having trouble sleeping, or perhaps sleeping too much?

My sleep has been terrible over the last two years. I struggle to fall asleep, wake up frequently during the night, and often wake up too early without being able to drift back off. Even when I do get some sleep, I always wake up feeling completely unrefreshed.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over these past two years?
Yes, I've noticed a big change. My appetite has decreased significantly almost every day, and I've ended up losing quite a bit of weight because of it. I just rarely feel like eating anymore.
How has your self-confidence or how you feel about yourself been over these past two years?

I haven't really thought about my self-confidence much, so I'm not entirely sure. I've just been feeling so empty and my mood has been so low for the last two years that it's hard to focus on anything else.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating, focusing on tasks, or making decisions over these past two years?
No, I haven't particularly noticed any difficulties with concentrating or making decisions. That hasn't really been an issue for me.
Over these past two years, have you been feeling hopeless about the future or your situation?
I'm not quite sure if I'd call it hopelessness, as I haven't really thought about it in those terms. It's more that I just feel a constant, heavy sadness and a sense of emptiness most of the time.
Have you had any thoughts of death, hurting yourself, or that you would be better off not being here?

Yes, I do frequently find myself wishing I wouldn't wake up in the morning, and I have thoughts of wanting to die. While these thoughts of wanting to not exist are persistent, I don't have any specific plan to hurt myself.
